n7560eec310.headline: Southern housing developer sees shares surge 26% in a week - VnExpress International
n7560eec310.summary: Social housing developer Hoang Quan Corp. has seen its stock rise 26% within one week. The government announced plans to prioritise credit for affordable housing projects.
n7560eec310.why: Housing developers depend on bank credit for project financing, so government credit priorities directly affect their funding and earnings outlook.

source.name: VnExpress International – Latest news, business, travel and analysis from Vietna

nde0d4ebe35.headline: Ofgem launches probe into British Gas over forced prepayment meter installations
nde0d4ebe35.summary: Ofgem chief executive Jonathan Brearley announced a comprehensive, independent review into forced prepayment meter installations by British Gas.
nde0d4ebe35.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator, and enforcement actions against suppliers such as British Gas owner Centrica affect the sector's regulatory risk.

naf8f1dcf3f.headline: Every fifth employee in Serbia works for an EU-based company
naf8f1dcf3f.summary: Serbian Minister Goran Vesić said politicians who advocate ending EU relations and accession are advocating economic ruin for Serbia. The remarks were tied to the share of workers employed by EU-based firms.
naf8f1dcf3f.why: Foreign-owned EU companies are a major source of employment and export earnings in Serbia, shaping its economic ties with the bloc.
